title: Brindlewood launches Lanes API for regional carriers
published: 2026-03-12
accessed: 2026-10-08
---
Brindlewood Freight Labs today launched the Lanes API, which lets carriers' own dispatch systems request optimized multi-stop routes. The company said it plans to extend the API to refrigerated freight in 2027.
